PreToolUse.description: Enforce traderkit risk gates on every broker write path (SnapTrade + TradeStation)

_comment: TradeStation was added to the matcher 2026-09-03. Until then docs/tradestation.md
told the reader to add mcp__tradestation__place_order by hand, so a broker with a
live order path sat outside the risk gates by default and only a reader who found
that one line would have known. A gate that has to be installed by hand on the
most dangerous tool is not a default.
Verbs come from broker_tradestation.py in autopilot-experiment: place_order,
are deliberately NOT matched: they place nothing, and gating them would train
the operator to click through the gate.
Adding a tool name that does not exist costs nothing (it never matches).
Omitting one that does costs an ungated real-money order, so this list errs
